dedupe_keys.name: country greenhouse gas emissions from the non renewable fraction of woodfuel used in households

description: FAO, UNIDO and Columbia University researchers publish country greenhouse-gas emissions attributed to the non-renewable fraction of woodfuel used by households. The CSV contains area names, ISO3 country codes, item and gas names, years, values and units. Country observations are accompanied by world and regional aggregates, although some aggregate rows lack ISO3 codes. Values are reported in kilotonnes. Zenodo provides public, free access under CC-BY-4.0. The inspected metadata does not state the full year range or explain the non-renewable fraction method, so these require the associated documentation before quantitative reuse. This uncertainty limits direct comparison with household fuel-consumption surveys. The table can inform scenarios that replace traditional household fuels and estimate resulting emission changes. It complements broader energy-emissions inventories by identifying this specific household biomass component. No CSV values were inspected or recalculated.
